probe.name: val-repr-permitted-freedoms
probe.rationale: Representation control exercising only the freedoms the public contract explicitly grants: (a) column alignment/trailing whitespace in LuxC.hmm is not compared — reserialize each numeric row with single-space separation (leading indent preserved) and print each 5-decimal value with an extra trailing zero (2.07294 -> 2.072940, identical value); (b) HMM numeric tolerance 2e-5 — deviate EFFN (1.989990 -> 1.990000) and all three STATS LOCAL lambda/mu values by exactly 1e-5 (half the tolerance); (c) LuxC.domtbl comment header lines are ignored — insert one; (d) domtbl tolerances — deviate the first row's full-sequence score by 0.05 (<=0.06), its full-sequence/c-/i-E-values by ~4.3-4.8% relative (<=5%) and its acc by 0.005 (<=0.006), and spell an E-value with an explicit mantissa (2.1e-169 vs 2e-169). Every changed value stays strictly inside the published tolerance bounds, so all checks must pass. The dominant application-relevant use of these tolerances is the fixed-width decimal serialization of HMMER values; this probe does not attempt any recomputation.
probe.script:
# Valid representation alternative. Exercise ONLY freedoms the public contract
# explicitly grants:
#  (a) LuxC.hmm: "Trailing whitespace and column alignment is not compared" --
#      re-emit the COMPO and per-position rows with single-space separation
#      (leading indent preserved), and reserialize each 5-decimal number with
#      an additional trailing zero (identical value, wider print).
#  (b) LuxC.hmm: numeric parameters have absolute tolerance 2e-5 -- deviate
#      EFFN and the STATS LOCAL calibration values by 1e-5 (half tolerance).
#  (c) LuxC.domtbl: comment header lines are ignored -- insert one.
#  (d) LuxC.domtbl: score tolerance 0.06, E-value relative tolerance 5%,
#      acc tolerance 0.006 -- deviate one row strictly inside each bound, and
#      spell an E-value with an explicit mantissa (2.0e-169 style vs 2e-169).
import re

# ---------- LuxC.hmm ----------
p = "LuxC.hmm"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
out = []
mode = 0  # 0 header, 1 after HMM header, 2 blocks
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith("EFFN "):
        assert ln.split()[1] == "1.989990"
        out.append("EFFN  1.990000")          # |diff| = 1e-5 <= 2e-5
        continue
    if ln.startswith("STATS LOCAL"):
        f = ln.split()
        lam = float(f[3]) + 0.00001             # |diff| = 1e-5 <= 2e-5
        mu = float(f[4]) + 0.00001
        out.append(" ".join(f[:3]) + " " + ("%8.4f %8.5f" % (lam, mu)))
        continue
    if mode == 0 and ln.startswith("HMM "):
        mode = 1
        out.append(ln)
        continue
    if mode == 1 and ln.lstrip().startswith("m->m"):
        mode = 2
        out.append(ln)
        continue
    if mode == 2 and ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("//"):
        lead = ln[: len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip())]  # keep leading indent exactly
        toks = ln.split()
        new = []
        for t in toks:
            if t == "*":
                new.append(t)
            elif re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+", t):
                new.append(t + "0")              # same value, wider print
            else:
                new.append(t)
        out.append(lead + " ".join(new))
        continue
    out.append(ln)
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(out))

# ---------- LuxC.domtbl ----------
p = "LuxC.domtbl"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
di = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("#")]
assert di and lines[di[0]].startswith("tr|B6ESM7|")
f = lines[di[0]].split(None, 22)
assert f[6] == "2e-169" and f[7] == "553.3" and f[11] == "2.3e-169" \
    and f[12] == "2.3e-169" and f[21] == "0.99"
f[6] = "2.1e-169"    # ~4.76% <= 5% relative, also explicit-mantissa spelling
f[7] = "553.25"      # |diff| = 0.05 <= 0.06
f[11] = "2.2e-169"   # ~4.35% <= 5%
f[12] = "2.4e-169"   # ~4.35% <= 5%
f[21] = "0.985"      # |diff| = 0.005 <= 0.006
lines[di[0]] = " ".join(f)
lines.insert(0, "# representation variation - comment lines are ignored")
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
print("done")

probe.name: w-hmm-parameter-values
probe.rationale: Perturbs every numerically-compared model parameter: EFFN 1.989990 -> 2.499990, each STATS LOCAL lambda/mu by +0.25/+0.02, every COMPO background log-odds by +0.30 and every per-position match emission, insert emission and transition probability by +0.30 (verified cell-by-cell: all 18798 numeric tokens moved by ~0.3, far beyond the 2e-5 absolute tolerance; the '*' zero-probability tokens are preserved as text). This is a plausible-looking but wrong model — e.g., a build with different priors, weighting or entropy targeting — while all identities (NAME/ACC/LENG/NSEQ/CKSUM/GA/TC/NC), the 400 position blocks and the '//' terminator are unchanged. Only hmm_model_parameters (and its number content) changes; the HMM still parses structurally and in position order.
probe.script:
# Perturb the numerically-compared model parameters: EFFN, STATS LOCAL calibration
# lines, the COMPO block and every per-position emission/insert/transition row.
import re
p = "LuxC.hmm"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
out = []
mode = 0  # 0 header, 1 after HMM header row, 2 in parameter block
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith("EFFN "):
        assert ln.split()[1] == "1.989990"
        out.append("EFFN  2.499990"); continue
    if ln.startswith("STATS LOCAL"):
        f = ln.split()
        out.append("%-21s %8.4f %8.5f" % (" ".join(f[:3]), float(f[3]) + 0.25, float(f[4]) + 0.02)); continue
    if ln.lstrip().startswith("COMPO"):
        toks = ln.split()[1:]
        lead = "COMPO   " if not ln.startswith("COMPO") else "COMPO   "
        vals = ["*" if t == "*" else "%.5f" % (float(t) + 0.30) for t in toks]
        out.append(lead + " ".join(vals)); continue
    if mode == 0 and ln.startswith("HMM "):
        mode = 1; out.append(ln); continue
    if mode == 1 and ln.lstrip().startswith("m->m"):
        mode = 2; out.append(ln); continue
    if mode == 2 and ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("//"):
        toks = ln.split()
        out_line = ["%.5f" % (float(t) + 0.30) if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.\d+", t) else t for t in toks]
        out.append(" " * 10 + " ".join(out_line)); continue
    out.append(ln)
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(out))
print("ok")

probe.name: w-domtbl-query-mismatch
probe.rationale: Changes the query (HMM) name, accession and length in every domtbl row to LuxD / PF05894.1 / 401 while LuxC.hmm is untouched. Every other domtbl field is byte-identical. This breaks only the cross-file consistency check (query name/accession/length vs the profile's NAME/ACC/LENG) — the exact scenario of searching the database with a different, plausible Lux-family model.
probe.script:
# Cross-file inconsistency: change the query name/accession/length in every
# domtbl row away from the HMM's NAME/ACC/LENG.
p = "LuxC.domtbl"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
changed = 0
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("#"):
        f = ln.split(None, 22)
        assert f[3] == "LuxC" and f[4] == "PF05893.5" and f[5] == "400", f[3:6]
        f[3] = "LuxD"
        f[4] = "PF05894.1"
        f[5] = "401"
        lines[i] = " ".join(f)
        changed += 1
assert changed == 12, changed
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
print("ok")

probe.name: w-domtbl-nonfinite-evalues
probe.rationale: Replaces the full-sequence E-value and independent per-domain E-value of the first row with the non-finite strings 'inf' and '-inf' (all other 12 rows/fields intact and parseable). The acceptance rules explicitly reject any non-finite or unparsable numeric value, so both the structure check (finite numeric columns) and the hits check (E-value comparison) must fail.

# Non-finite numeric values in the domain table (rejected values).
p = "LuxC.domtbl"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
data_idx = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("#")]

i = data_idx[0]

assert f[0] == "tr|B6ESM7|B6ESM7_ALISL"
assert f[6] == "2e-169" and f[12] == "2.3e-169"

lines[i] = " ".join(f)
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(lines))

probe.name: w-domtbl-tolerance-boundary
probe.rationale: Deviation just beyond every domtbl numeric tolerance in a single row: full-sequence score 553.3 -> 553.37 (|diff| = 0.07 > 0.06), c-Evalue 2.3e-169 -> 2.5e-169 (~8.7% > 5% relative), acc 0.99 -> 0.997 (|diff| = 0.007 > 0.006). Constraint-solver style: probes the acceptance boundary itself rather than an obvious order-of-magnitude error, confirming the tolerance rule actually rejects values that exceed it by the smallest printed increment.
probe.script:
# Tolerance-boundary wrong result: deviate scores/E-values/acc of one row by
# just beyond the stated tolerances (0.06 score, 5% relative E-value, 0.006 acc).
p = "LuxC.domtbl"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
di = [i for i, ln in enumerate(lines) if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("#")]
assert di and lines[di[0]].startswith("tr|B6ESM7|")
f = lines[di[0]].split(None, 22)
assert f[7] == "553.3" and f[11] == "2.3e-169" and f[21] == "0.99"
f[7] = "553.37"      # |diff| = 0.07 > 0.06
f[11] = "2.5e-169"   # ~8.7% > 5%
f[21] = "0.997"      # |diff| = 0.007 > 0.006
lines[di[0]] = " ".join(f)
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
print("ok")

probe.name: w-hmm-tolerance-boundary
probe.rationale: Deviation just beyond the 2e-5 absolute HMM tolerance, applied to three different kinds of compared values: EFFN 1.989990 -> 1.990013 (2.3e-5 off), a STATS LOCAL MSV lambda/mu pair by 3e-5, and the position-1 match emission 2.07294 -> 2.07297 (3e-5). Everything else is identical. This probes the acceptance boundary for exactly-serialized values rather than a large error, verifying the grader's absolute-tolerance rule rejects deviations that exceed half of one printed decimal unit.
probe.script:
# Tolerance-boundary wrong result in the profile HMM: deviate EFFN, one STATS
# parameter and a single position-1 emission value by just beyond the 2e-5
# absolute tolerance.
p = "LuxC.hmm"
lines = open(p).read().split("\n")
seen = 0
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.startswith("EFFN "):
        assert ln.split()[1] == "1.989990"
        lines[i] = "EFFN  1.990013"            # diff 2.3e-5 > 2e-5
        seen += 1
    elif ln.startswith("STATS LOCAL MSV"):
        f = ln.split()
        lines[i] = " ".join(f[:3]) + " " + ("%8.5f %8.5f" % (float(f[3]) - 0.00003, float(f[4]) + 0.00003))
        seen += 1
    elif seen >= 2 and ln.startswith("      1 "):
        toks = ln.split()
        assert toks[0] == "1" and toks[1] == "2.07294"
        toks[1] = "2.07297"                    # diff 3e-5 > 2e-5
        lines[i] = "      " + "  ".join(toks)
        seen += 1
        break
assert seen == 3, seen
open(p, "w").write("\n".join(lines))
print("ok")
